title: Exclude three funded repair families for the BIT packet-971 candidate
body:
All 21 paired receiver swaps at the original clocks, all 512 roster mixed directions, and all 74 named fourth omissions fail their respective stock or output tests.

## Scope and source

Pins #7931 and the exact x341=x340 projected control with 968, 971 and 1564 omitted. The paired retiming phase had no survivors. Mixed directions are a finite 512-case roster. The fourth-omission proof covers one new pulse into chart 178 and both x51-capable and no-x51 branches. The source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit971-three-funded-screens/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. The three cold inner replays checked the 21-pair census, 489 independent XOR witnesses and 23 exact kernels, and 142 stock plus six output-parity witnesses. Protected native and mutation controls are included. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Move outside these scopes through a joint retiming, different mixed direction, or multi-pulse changed topology. The favorable projected price still needs a literal protected supplier.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
